sentences.text: Kane and Bellingham made their views clear at the review England players are understood to have aired strong views about their World Cup semi-final defeat by Argentina in a team meeting.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: As BBC Sport reported in September, the Football Association (FA) process included canvassing the opinions of the squad - and it has emerged that took place at a 'full and frank' meeting with head coach Thomas Tuchel at the start of the September international break.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: BBC Sport has been told the squad feel that now they have been able to have their say, they can move on from their heartbreak in Atlanta on 15 July.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: And this was demonstrated in the last international break when England, after a narrow defeat by Spain in the first game, went on to win the next three matches impressively.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: In particular there was unhappiness about how Tuchel told them to approach the closing stages of the game after Anthony Gordon had given them a 55th-minute advantage.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Enzo Fernandez struck an equaliser with five minutes left, before Lautaro Martinez headed in a stoppage-time winner.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: As reported by BBC Sport at the time, a number of senior England players held misgivings at Tuchel's instructions for the closing stages of the Argentina loss, believing the approach was too negative and defensive.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Hindsight, of course, is 20/20.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: England appeared to retreat in the closing stages of the last-16 tie against Mexico earlier in the tournament - but successfully defended a 3-2 lead to reach the quarter-finals to trigger scenes of joy at the iconic Azteca Stadium.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Nevertheless, certain players felt let down by the team's apparent pragmatism during the closing stages of the loss to Argentina amid a sense that going for the South Americans' jugular would have provided greater success.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Inevitably, the game against Argentina emerged as a key theme at the squad discussion.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: It is understood that Tuchel pointed to the quality of the opposition as a key factor on why they eventually succumbed to two late Argentina goals.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: There is, of course, merit to that argument.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Lionel Messi was in the opposition team after all.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: That said, it was not an argument the players in the meeting were prepared to universally accept.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: There is a strongly held view within the England squad that their team, man-for-man, was superior to Argentina, who had 38-year-old Nicolas Otamendi on the field for the closing 18 minutes of the game.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: All players were afforded an opportunity to air their personal views during the meeting.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: As you would expect, captain Harry Kane was strong and forthright with his views.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Jude Bellingham, too, is said to have been particularly candid in expressing his belief that this current crop of England players were more than capable of continuing to take the game to Argentina.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Bellingham's contribution to the meeting is said to have underlined his growing influence within the England squad, with many believing the Real Madrid midfielder will become the team's captain once Kane is no longer in the picture.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: If the air needed to be cleared after the World Cup then it appears those honest discussions at the end of September did the trick.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Barring the 3-2 defeat by Spain at Wembley in their first Nations League fixture in September, England have bounced back from the loss to Argentina emphatically - scoring 12 goals without conceding in three fixtures against the Czech Republic and Croatia.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Similarly, the fluctuating relationship between Bellingham and Tuchel seems to have improved, too.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: "It was a bit of an up and down [relationship] of course but we are in a good place," Tuchel said last week.
sentences.article_title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review

sentences.text: Ben White made his first England appearance in more than three years against Uruguay in March Arsenal defender Ben White says people do not know the "full story" behind his decision to previously make himself unavailable for England selection - but says he would make the same decision again.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: White, who has been named in Thomas Tuchel's squad for upcoming Nations League fixtures, left the Three Lions' camp at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar to return home for personal reasons.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: He then made himself unavailable for selection for the rest of Gareth Southgate's reign, and was booed by some fans in March's 1-1 draw with Ukraine after returning to the squad under Tuchel.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: Asked by BBC Radio 5 live's football correspondent John Murray what he would say to people who define his England career by what happened in Qatar, White said: "I think obviously people don't know the full story, because I [have] never said anything and I won't put anyone under the bus or share any of that.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: "I think that is probably the best way.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: "It's been amazing [though], obviously a bit tricky and not straightforward, but it is amazing to be here now." White is now 29 and asked if he would have done anything differently in hindsight, he added: "No, I don't think I would.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: "Obviously, I was a bit younger, I am a bit older now.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: "I think as a person I am quite real and I think I made the decision that I would probably continue to make.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: "So, one that I am not happy about, but obviously it happened and [it is] time to move on." White came on for his first England appearance since 2022 in March's 1-1 draw with Uruguay and was booed by some supporters before he scored but also gave away the penalty that led to the visitors' equaliser.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: After that, Chelsea midfielder Jordan Henderson said he and his fellow England players would always support White, while Tuchel said recently that the defender deserves "a new chapter" and "positive feedback from the crowd".
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: Asked how he dealt with the emotions of that night at Wembley, White added: "Before the game I was thinking 'don't not stand out, but [take it] nice and easy'.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: "Then I came on and obviously got booed, then I scored, then I gave away a penalty.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: "So, it was obviously full of emotions that night, [but] it was a good night." England play Croatia at Wembley on Thursday, 12 November before taking on world champions Spain in Madrid three days later.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: White is looking to add to his six England caps in this international break and said: "It is obviously an amazing privilege to be called up.
sentences.article_title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White

sentences.text: "The feeling is the same every time you do get this chance to play for England.

sentences.text: Kenyan police have seized 454kg (1,000lb) of methamphetamine worth an estimated $27m (£20m) in an operation targeting international drug trafficking networks.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: Three suspects, two Tanzanians and a Ugandan, were arrested at the Kenyan coast following an intelligence-led operation involving Kenyan anti-narcotics officers and their Tanzanian counterparts.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: Police said the investigations began after a key suspect was arrested in Tanzania last week and handed over to Kenyan authorities at the border.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: Methamphetamine, commonly known as meth, is a harmful illegal synthetic drug that is highly addictive and can lead to severe psychosis, heart attack or stroke.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: The haul is one of the largest drug seizures in Kenya's history.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: The suspect, who was allegedly linked to a separate seizure of 299kg of suspected methamphetamine and heroin in Tanzania, led officers to a location in Msambweni on the Kenyan coast, where the drug haul was discovered.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: Police made further arrests at the site and seized two motor vehicles and a motorcycle.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: Aretas Lyimo, head of Tanzania's Drug Control and Enforcement Authority (DCEA), says initial questioning indicated that the drugs found in Tanzania had come through the Kenyan port of Mombasa.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: He added that investigations suggested that some of those arrested were key figures in an international drug trafficking network operating across several countries, including Afghanistan, South Africa, Mozambique, Zambia, Malawi, Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania and UAE.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: A total of seven suspects were arrested in the two locations, five Tanzanians and two Ugandans, he said.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: The four suspects in Kenya are currently in custody and due to be arraigned in court, while the recovered narcotics and the seized items are being kept as exhibits.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: The police say the operation remains ongoing and urged members of the public to to share information that will help tackle drug trafficking.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: Last month, Kenya's Deputy President Kithure Kindiki declared illicit alcohol and drug abuse to be among the country's top threats.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: He warned that the government would introduce tougher laws and intensify nationwide operations to deal with the menace.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: In a separate operation last month, authorities destroyed more than a tonne of methamphetamine from a consignment intercepted last year by the Kenyan navy about 630km (390 miles) off the Mombasa coast.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: The Institute for Security Studies, a think-tank, has warned of a shift in East Africa's role in international drug trafficking.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: It says the region's coastline is increasingly becoming not just a transit route for drugs destined for other markets but also an entry point for manufactured drugs intended for local consumption.
sentences.article_title: Kenya seizes 454kg of meth in drug crackdown

sentences.text: "I'm going to post my pictures and say good things about what I'm experiencing.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I'm going to promote it," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: For Sucdi, that potential is personal.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She is continuing a family profession while building a business in an industry with few women and using digital platforms to reach audiences far beyond Mogadishu.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "Somalia still has a long way to go before tourism becomes a major industry," she says.

sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: It was an unlikely greeting to hear at a Democratic Party victory rally after the US midterm elections.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Abdul El-Sayed , 42, born to Egyptian immigrant parents, playfully addressed Vice-President JD Vance, who had campaigned against him but will now swear him into office in January as Michigan's new Senator.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: The US-born Democrat spent much of his campaign fending off attacks from conservative media and President Donald Trump, who accused him of supporting the Muslim Brotherhood.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: El-Sayed rejected the allegations.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: "My name is Abdul Rahman Mohammed El-Sayed," he said in an Egyptian Arabic accent to the cheering crowd at his victory rally.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: His Arabic Muslim name was a target for many of his opponents.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: He is set to become the first Muslim senator.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: El-Sayed ran a social media-first campaign, with TikTok edits showing him speaking directly to young voters, tapping into Gen Z humour, and sporting friendship bracelets.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: The former public health administrator's campaign centred on a progressive agenda, including Medicare for All, affordable housing and curbing corporate influence in politics.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: He has also been a vocal critic of US military aid to Israel.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: But El-Sayed was not alone.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: From an Ethiopian-born Gen Z congresswoman to candidates with Nigerian heritage, several other politicians with African roots won in this year's midterms.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: The elections, held halfway through a president's four-year term, decide who represents Americans in Congress, as well as in thousands of state and local offices.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Born in Addis Ababa, Melat Kiros' family moved to Denver when she was a baby At 29, Melat Kiros became the first Gen Z woman elected to the US Congress.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Born in Ethiopia, she arrived in the US as a baby and grew up in Denver.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: She had never held elected office before defeating a 15-term incumbent in Colorado's 1st District in the Democrat primary before winning a landslide in Tuesday's election.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Kiros, like El-Sayed, campaigned on issues that have become central to young progressive voters: the cost of living, universal childcare and Medicare for All.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Endorsed by the Democratic Socialists of America, she has also called for abolishing Immigration and Customs Enforcement and ending US military aid to Israel.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Her outspoken criticism of Israel's war in Gaza has attracted controversy.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Kiros has said her criticism is directed at the Israeli state, not Jewish people.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: She was fired from a top New York law firm in 2023 after she refused to take down an open letter to dozens of law firms who had urged law school deans to crack down on antisemitism on campuses as students engaged in pro-Palestinian protests.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Kiros condemned antisemitism, but warned the law firms, including the one she worked for, against conflating "such bigotry with the geo-political question of Israel's legitimacy".
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: She said she started thinking more seriously about politics in general after being fired.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Adrian Boafo's parents moved from Ghana to the US Adrian Boafo, meanwhile, a second-generation Ghanaian-American, will represent Maryland's 5th Congressional District after succeeding veteran Congressman Steny Hoyer, who retired after a political career spanning more than four decades.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: The 32-year-old was born in Virginia and raised in Prince George's County, Maryland.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: His parents immigrated to the US from Ghana.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Boafo's route to Congress began in local politics.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: He served on the Bowie City Council before becoming a Maryland state delegate in 2023.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: He also worked for Hoyer before eventually winning the race to replace him.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: His campaign focused on the cost of living, childcare and protecting federal workers, a major issue in a district close to Washington DC and home to thousands of government employees.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: In his victory statement, Boafo said representing his constituents had "never felt more urgent", pointing to federal job cuts, rising costs and the Trump administration's immigration crackdown.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Among those returning to Congress is Somali-born Ilhan Omar, 44, who won a fifth term despite an ongoing federal investigation.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Federal agents searched her Washington home in October as part of an investigation into her immigration paperwork.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Omar has denied wrongdoing and has not been charged with a crime.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: First elected to Congress in 2018, Omar became the first Somali-American and one of the first Muslim women to serve in the chamber.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: She has also been a frequent target of President Trump, who has repeatedly criticised her and other Somali immigrants.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Trump has previously used derogatory language to describe some African countries, including Somalia.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: In October, his Yemeni-born adviser Amer Ghalib said the president would refrain from using such language.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Others made their breakthroughs in state and local politics.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Junior Ezeonu was born in Nigeria and moved to the US as a young child.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: By 27, he had already become Grand Prairie's youngest city council member before winning a seat in the Texas State House.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: Then there is Carol Kazeem , 34, a Pennsylvania state legislator of Nigerian heritage who has retained her seat at District 159.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: At least four candidates with Nigerian heritage won in the 3 November midterms.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: For some young Africans watching from across the Atlantic, these victories have offered a glimpse of what a new generation of voters could achieve at home.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: On social media, users have shared the election results as a source of inspiration, particularly in Nigeria and Kenya, where major elections are due in 2027.
sentences.article_title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

sentences.text: More than 500 parties are contesting the elections South Africans are voting in highly contested local elections likely to see a haemorrhaging of votes for the country's biggest party, the African National Congress (ANC).
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: This year's voting season has been marked by intense campaigns that have included politicians spinning cars, watching grannies knit and even wading through giant-sized potholes.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Election officials say voting is going smoothly, despite long queues at some polling stations.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Leaders are campaigning to head South Africa's nearly 300 municipalities, responsible for basic service provision such as water, electricity and refuse collection.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: For the ANC, the elections are a chance to prove it still has what it takes to govern.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The party had a disastrous showing in the last national election, when it lost its parliamentary majority for the first time since 1994 when the racist apartheid system ended.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Support for the party has been dropping significantly over the years because of anger over high levels of corruption, unemployment and crime.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: At its peak, in 2004, the ANC got 70% of the vote in the general election.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Two decades later its share dropped to 40%.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Polls and pundits have predicted a further loss in these elections but President Cyril Ramaphosa has denied that his party was in a downward spiral.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "What I'm seeing here is that the ANC is going higher and higher and on the 4th [of November] we will show those naysayers," he told supporters at the party's final election rally on Sunday.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: In townships like Alexandra, north-east of Johannesburg, the ANC has traditionally had a strong supporter base but poor governance and voter apathy are unravelling this support.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The BBC visited the sprawling township a week before the elections and spoke to residents to get their views.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: One of them was Sanele Ntombela, who is a first-time voter excited to make his voice heard.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Sanele Ntombela (left), seen here with his friends Tshiamo Mbange (centre) and Lwandle Dladla, is excited to cast his vote We found the 18-year-old hanging out with his friends on a street corner.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Most of his friends said they had no intention of voting and had not registered to do so.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: They cited a lack of change and deteriorating delivery of basic services.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: But Ntombela was looking forward to voting for the first time and thought it might lead to change.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "We face many challenges in Alexandra.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: There's rubbish everywhere and we struggle with electricity and water and many other issues," he said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Just metres away, heaps of rubbish lay gathered beneath a streetlight pole covered in election posters from the different political parties.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: On the other side of the street, drain water trickles through the many potholes that have gutted that part of the road.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The ANC faces immense pressure to reverse years of decline The BBC also spoke to Zandile Mncube, who said she wouldn't vote, even though she is registered to do so.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The 33-year-old woman also cited poor service delivery and performance by local leaders for her decision.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "It makes no difference [whether I vote or not].
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Things have gotten worse over the years," she said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Alex, as the township is known, is a stone's throw away from Sandton, Africa's richest square mile, but the differences could not be starker.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Sandton is known for its skyscrapers, designer shops and well-maintained roads but in Alex, houses are sandwiched together and rubbish, either piled together or left strewn across the pavement, is everywhere.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The stench of raw sewage and uncollected rubbish is heavy in the air, but residents appear used to it.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The issues plaguing Alexandra are not unique.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: A drive around Gauteng province reveals similar patterns of neglect and disrepair, especially in the townships.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: South of Johannesburg, Soweto looks marginally cleaner than Alexandra, but residents also complain about service delivery.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Mduduzi Makhubo, 45, has lived in Soweto his entire life and he told the BBC of the community's daily struggles with accessing water and electricity.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "Every Monday we know we won't have water after 2pm," he said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Makhubo is registered to vote and intends to use his vote to deal with the "arrogance" he says local leaders have towards residents and "change the status quo".
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Can this man broaden the appeal of a South African party seen by some as 'too white'?
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: South Africa's political marriage of convenience avoids divorce - just These areas offer a small, but important, glimpse into the state of South Africa's local governance.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Years of reports by the auditor-general have highlighted the dire state of most of South Africa's 257 municipalities.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: A recent report only gave 39 clean audits - the highest ranking a public entity can achieve - between 2024 and 2025.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: None of Gauteng's three metro cities, Johannesburg, Tshwane and Ekurhuleni, featured in this list.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Earlier this year auditor-general Tsakani Maluleke said Johannesburg "needs ongoing attention".
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "If we don't that, we are going to continue on this slide where financial health deteriorates [and] where service delivery continues to be compromised, which is what we are living," she told lawmakers.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The city has been labelled "effectively bankrupt" due to the dire state of its finances.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Dirty streets, unstable electricity supply and persistent water issues have been common for years.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Experts the BBC spoke to agreed that all eyes will be on Africa's wealthiest city as well as the country's seven other biggest municipalities, or metros, particularly those in Gauteng when the results come in.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Of South Africa's eight metros, only three are governed by a single party.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: In Gauteng, all three metros are governed by coalition governments, with the ANC the largest party.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Political analyst Melanie Verwoerd said the elections would be a "verdict ... and judgment" on the ANC.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "And the expectation is that the ANC generally in the country is going to [perform] the worst it's ever done," she said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Several polls point to a continued decline in support for the party in Wednesday's election, contested by over 500 political parties.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: One, conducted by Ipsos, put the ANC's support at 30%, down from the 46% it got at the last local elections in 2021.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The same poll, along with others, points to a slight increase in electoral support for the Democratic Alliance (DA), especially in Johannesburg.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Ipsos predicts the DA will garner 25% support in this election, up from 22% last time.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: DA leader Helen Zille has been vying for the mayoral chain in the city and her unusual campaign has attracted a lot of attention.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The former Cape Town mayor has been captured swimming in crater-sized potholes, ziplining over sinkholes and riding into her final rally in the city in a classic BMW 325i, known locally as a "Gusheshe".
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: She believes the DA is the country's best choice for a government, telling local radio broadcaster 702 last week that "towns and cities that work best are under DA governance".
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Verwoerd, a former ANC MP and South Africa's ambassador to Ireland, predicted that coalitions would continue being the order of the day across Gauteng.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: These types of arrangements have often been viewed as unstable and chaotic at a local level and the constant change in leadership, usually caused by parties falling out with each other, has affected service delivery in many municipalities.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Zandile Mncube says things have got worse in her township over the years Verwoerd said in her view, the most stable coalitions would be those that replicate what the ANC and DA have done on a national level, where the historic rivals have agreed to share power.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Reflecting on Cape Town, she said it was unlikely that the DA would lose control of the municipality.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The coastal city is widely considered the country's best-performing metro and has been run by the DA since the late 2000s when it unseated the ANC.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Ethekwini, which includes the port city of Durban in KwaZulu-Natal, would be a "different story", Verwoerd said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) Party has been projected to perform well in the area but it is unclear if it will secure the outright majority needed to run the metro.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Polls suggest it won't and will need partners to form a government.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The party was founded by former South African President Jacob Zuma and was the biggest party across his home province of KwaZulu-Natal in the 2024 provincial election.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Verwoerd reflected that while various options were on the table for the party, forming a government would be "very messy" given its refusal to work with either the ANC or DA.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: A confident Zuma, addressing supporters on Sunday, vowed to take control of a number of municipalities after the elections.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Another political analyst Dr Levy Ndou echoed Verwoerd's assessment, saying that a coalition between the DA and ANC seemed unavoidable in most metros.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "We're not sure whether the arrangement of the government of national unity could have the potential to influence how the metros are going to be run," he said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Both experts also spoke about the declining voter turnout in South Africa's elections.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Over 29 million citizens are registered to vote, but the turnout, especially among young people, has seen a steady decline.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Ndou attributed this to the "calibre" of the candidates campaigning and the lack of visibility of local councillors, who are often the ones elected to lead their neighbourhoods, in election campaigns.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: South Africa's electoral commission has seven days to announce the results, but parties have 14 days to form a governing structure.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Mohamed Salah has scored 10 goals in 15 games for Turkish club Trabzonspor Back in August, when Mohamed Salah landed in Istanbul after flying in from his holiday in Mykonos, he wore Trabzonspor's burgundy and blue home strip as he stepped out of the plane to be greeted by thousands of fans.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: That kit sold out almost instantly.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: Later that day, as Salah headed to Trabzon in north-east Turkey to complete the formalities of one of the most unexpected transfers after the expiry of his Liverpool contract , he asked one of his entourage what he should wear.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: "The same kit," came the response, but Trabzonspor president Ertugrul Dogan advised Salah to wear the black away kit instead.

sentences.text: Of course, that sold out too.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: From the outset of the 34-year-old's arrival to this historic port city on the Black Sea, that sense of adulation has only grown.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: "I went to the airport to see him in Istanbul and it was surreal," says Nisa Dumangoz.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: "I still can't believe that he is one of us." Go for a stroll through Trabzon on matchday and it is Salah's face which adorns everything.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: Even the walls inside the fishmongers have pictures of him.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: At the club shop in town, one of the staff jokes that the ground floor is for the Egyptian and the upper floor is for everything else.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: Outside the stadium, there are scarves, magnets, keyrings, lighters with his face on and Egyptian Nemes headdresses in Trabzonspor colours.

sentences.text: Season ticket sales rocketed after his arrival.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: "Walking around Trabzon, it feels as though nine out of every 10 fans wearing a shirt have Salah's name on the back.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: The 10th has their own," says Turkish football journalist Hasan Tuncel.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: The club have surpassed their merchandise revenue from last year in three months since Salah's arrival, while the local airport is only getting busier.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: Liverpool was difficult to reach for many supporters across the Arab world and tickets were often hard to source.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: Trabzon is far more accessible, with new flights introduced from Cairo, Dubai and Riyadh since Salah's arrival.
sentences.article_title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon

sentences.text: On our flight from Istanbul, we meet an Egyptian family of 10 coming from Cairo for Trabzonspor's Uefa Conference League game against Freiburg.

sentences.text: "He is our ambassador and our Egyptian King, and with how many people want to come to Turkey now, he is their ambassador too," says Mahmoud.

sentences.text: The Confederation of African Football (Caf) will instead retain the tournament's traditional biennial staging, with its president Patrice Motsepe saying the U-turn was based on "advancing, protecting and promoting" the interests of the African game.

sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: Afcon has predominantly been held every two years since its first edition in 1957, barring two three-year gaps in the 1960s and one year between the 2012 and 2013 tournaments.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: On the eve of the 2025 finals in Morocco, Motsepe announced all that would change from 2028.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: The South African said the shift to a four-year cycle was, in part, to help the global calendar "be significantly more synchronised and harmonised".
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: In recent years Afcon has been staged midway through the European club season, leading to recurring disputes over the release of African players.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: Fifa general secretary Mattias Grafstrom was sitting aside Motsepe when the plan was announced, and critics highlighted that the scheduling change favoured football's world governing body more than the African game.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: "I think the general sentiment around the continent has been that the two-year cycle has served the continent very well," Football Association of Zambia (Faz) official Sydney Mungala told the BBC.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: In its stead, an annual Africa Nations League involving all 54 countries on the continent was proposed.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: Motsepe described the ambition as creating a "world-class competition every year".
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: The idea was to move beyond Caf's heavy reliance on Afcon and develop a more sustainable commercial model which could support football development.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: Yet the last time an ambitious alternative competition took place in Africa, it failed to deliver on its financial promise and was quickly ditched.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: The Africa Super League, announced by Caf in 2022 to revolutionise continental club competition, and with projected annual revenues of $200m (£149m), was discontinued after just one edition.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: Motsepe later acknowledged that commercial deals fell short of expectations.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: "We didn't proceed as quickly because the partners that were giving us money were not giving us the deals we thought we would be happy with," he said.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: The decision to move to a four-year cycle was taken at a meeting of Caf's executive committee last December - without being tabled at a general assembly where all member nations are represented.

sentences.text: "Afcon is the locomotive by which Caf funds all of its other competitions." sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: Motsepe said the decision was in the "best interest of African football" and would contribute to the development and growth of the sport.
sentences.article_title: Why has Caf abandoned plans to hold Afcon every four years?

sentences.text: He also admitted misgivings about the new Nations League, with concerns it would require "several years" before it could make "the substantial financial and football development contributions" to help the continental game be "self-supporting".

sentences.text: That has not stopped the South African cultivating a close relationship with his counterpart and Infantino's drive to expand the Fifa World Cup to 48 teams - and in the process increase African representation at the tournament - has won him backing across the continent.

sentences.text: Yiech Pur Biel (left) is leading the first ever refugee team at the Youth Olympics When he started running, Yiech Pur Biel had to compete barefoot.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: Far from home in a new country, it was the first step towards rebuilding his life as a refugee.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: "That's when I decided now it is time to depend on myself and also to start a new life with determination," he tells BBC Newsbeat.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: In 2016, Biel made history competing in the 800m event as part of the first Olympic refugee team at the Rio summer Olympics in Brazil.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: Ten years on, he's making history again leading the first refugee team for the Youth Olympics as their Chef de Mission.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: Joining almost 3,000 athletes, the small team of six will be wanting to make sure their debut counts - but Biel says they're also hoping to send a message that "refugees still need our help".
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: Hosted in Senegal, Saturday's opening ceremony will launch the first ever Olympic sporting event on African soil.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: Africa is home to nearly 45 million displaced people, out of almost 120 million globally, representing the world's biggest displacement crisis.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: Biel says for the refugee team, the Youth Olympics is "a chance for them to tell the world and also to represent the population, especially the refugee population, in Africa".
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: He ended up in Kenya, telling BBC Newsbeat: "It traumatised me, starting a new life, being alone in Kakuma," referring to the major refugee settlement close to the border between Kenya and South Sudan.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: "But I started a new life, I believe that school helped me a lot.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: It helped me to interact with young people who faced the same challenges." The rest of his childhood was spent on the refugee camp where he took an interest in football.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: After realising it wasn't the sport for him, he gave running a go during trials set up by the International Olympic Committee - where he raced without shoes.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: It made him "believe that if I can work harder by myself, I can achieve", he says.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: Arno Yafunga Botay is one of six athletes competing for the Refugee Olympic Team at the Dakar 2026 Youth Games One of the athletes on the refugee team, Arno Yafunga Botay, also lived at Kakuma after fleeing his home in the Democratic Republic of Congo in 2017, when he was six.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: Now 15, he will be competing in judo and told BBC Sport Africa he's promised to bring back a gold medal which he'd like to take to the refugee camp.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: "I think if I achieve [a] gold medal, I can go there and teach them the value of judo," he said.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: As for Biel, he says it's an honour to be chosen as the team's Chef de Mission.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: "This is so important for them, to learn from my experience as an athlete and also as a refugee who is coming from a refugee camp," he says.
sentences.article_title: Refugee athlete to make history for second time at Youth Olympics

sentences.text: "So this role means a lot to me and also means a lot to those young athletes who are going to compete." Competition at Dakar 2026 begins later, with the opening ceremony on Saturday.

sentences.text: In this episode Mike Wooldridge hears Sr Rosemary’s astonishing story.

sentences.text: The feared rebel group, the Lord’s Resistance Army, started to terrorise the north of Uganda in the 1980s.
sentences.article_title: The Documentary Podcast

sentences.text: Many children, girls as well as boys, were abducted and forced to become child soldiers.
sentences.article_title: The Documentary Podcast

sentences.text: In many cases, the LRA forced them to commit atrocities, leaving them deeply traumatised.
sentences.article_title: The Documentary Podcast

sentences.text: Many of the girls also bore the children of rebel leaders.
sentences.article_title: The Documentary Podcast

sentences.text: As they started to return home, these children were often rejected by their families and communities, says Sr Rosemary.
sentences.article_title: The Documentary Podcast

sentences.text: So she set about giving them a future and a hope: through enabling them to acquire skills like sewing, and by helping them see that God had not rejected them for the atrocities they had been forced to commit.

sentences.text: More than once, Sr Rosemary put herself in enormous danger in order to fulfil her mission.
sentences.article_title: The Documentary Podcast

sentences.text: But, she says, she also learnt that small acts of kindness can touch the hearts of even battle-hardened rebels.

sentences.text: Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's National Party is set to lose several senior lawmakers after the election Who will form New Zealand's next government remains uncertain after the country's national election on Saturday, with final results not due for another couple of weeks.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: It's the tightest vote that the country has seen in years, with the incumbent National Party and opposition Labour Party neck-and-neck in terms of party vote share.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: In terms of seats, a National-led conservative coalition, which includes the Act Party and NZ First, are projected to win a combined 67 seats - giving them a narrow one-seat majority.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: As questions about other coalitions swirl, party leaders are remaining tight-lipped, saying they would wait for the final results before formal discussions.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: Major parties on both sides of the political aisle were "likely dissatisfied with their campaigns", Max Rashbrooke, adjunct senior research fellow at the Victoria University of Wellington, told the BBC.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: The opposition Labour Party, led by Chris Hipkins, ran an election campaign that "seems to have inspired few voters", despite going up against Christopher Luxon, a "historically unpopular prime minister", Rashbrooke said.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: On the other hand, he added, the incumbent National Party also "failed to spark enthusiasm" even though it "should have been safe" given the country hasn't seen a one-term government in more than 50 years.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: The election dealt a huge blow to National with the loss of some of its most senior lawmakers, including Finance Minister Nicola Willis, Justice Minister Paul Goldsmith, Transport Minister Chris Bishop and House Speaker Gerry Brownlee.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: Act Party leader David Seymour has expressed interest in the finance minister portfolio, telling news outlet Stuff that National must recognise the voters' message and let its coalition partners play a bigger role.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: "The government barely survived, it must now put its best foot forward in every step," he said.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: The big winners of election night were "the more radical minor parties", Rashbrooke said.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: The left-leaning Greens and the right-wing libertarian Act Party both saw new highs this election, while the Opportunity Party, a fledgling centrist party, scored a breakout victory.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: Having previously failed three times at getting into Parliament, it's now projected to get seven seats.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: Opportunity's incoming lawmakers, including leader Qiulae Wong, arrived at New Zealand's parliament on Monday morning, for the start of what Wong said would be a week of "induction stuff".
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: Opportunity, led by Qiulae Wong (front centre), says it's open to joining to forming a coalition with either major party Opportunity, which has rejected traditional political divisions, has said it's open to forming a coalition with either major party.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: Whichever coalition they join, though, they would "really need to be comfortable with the overall direction the government is going in", Wong told reporters on Monday.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: Wong said that although she has received calls of congratulations from Labour's Hipkins and the Greens' Chlöe Swarbrick, they have not had any discussions about coalitions.
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.text: Luxon, who had previously ruled out working with Opportunity, told public broadcaster RNZ on Monday that he wanted to talk to Wong "shortly".
sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

sentences.article_title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks
